g1_onchain_valuation.label: On-Chain Valuation
g1_onchain_valuation.description: MVRV, SOPR, NUPL, Exchange Reserve — valuation & holder behavior

mvrv_z_score.description: MVRV Z-Score: market value vs realized value, normalized. High = overvalued.
mvrv_z_score.evidence: Grobys et al.; CryptoQuant; LookIntoBitcoin — top/bottom predictor

sopr.description: STH-SOPR: spent output profit ratio. >1 = selling at profit.

nupl.description: NUPL: net unrealized profit/loss. Derived from MVRV.

exchange_reserve.description: BTC Exchange Reserve: total BTC held on exchanges.
exchange_reserve.evidence: On-chain supply pressure metric; rising = potential selling

g2_derivatives_sentiment.label: Derivatives Sentiment
g2_derivatives_sentiment.description: Funding Rate, OI, Taker Ratio, Liquidations — leverage & futures positioning

funding_rate.description: BTC Funding Rate (7d avg): cost of holding longs in futures.
funding_rate.evidence: WhalePortal: 'funding rates are most powerful'; real-time leverage sentiment

taker_buy_sell_ratio.description: Taker Buy/Sell Ratio (7d avg): aggressive market buying vs selling.
taker_buy_sell_ratio.evidence: Spot market pressure indicator; high = buyers in control

liquidation_ratio.description: Long/Short Liquidation Ratio: long liqs / (long + short liqs).

g3_supply_flow.label: Supply Flow
g3_supply_flow.description: Exchange Netflow, Stablecoin Reserve, Whale Ratio — supply/demand pressure

exchange_netflow.description: BTC Exchange Netflow (7d sum): inflow - outflow. Positive = selling pressure.
exchange_netflow.evidence: Chi et al. (2024): exchange flow predicts BTC returns significantly

stablecoin_reserve.description: Stablecoin Exchange Reserve (7d change): proxy for incoming capital.
stablecoin_reserve.evidence: BitcoinFoundation 2026: 'stablecoin supply growth = proxy for incoming capital'

whale_ratio.description: Exchange Whale Ratio (7d avg): top 10 inflows / total inflows.

g4_technical_momentum.label: Technical Momentum
g4_technical_momentum.description: RSI, MACD, Price vs SMA-200 — price trend & momentum

rsi.evidence: Classic momentum indicator; used in every quantitative framework

macd_hist.description: MACD Histogram (7d MA trend): momentum direction and strength.
macd_hist.evidence: Trend confirmation; widely used in quantitative strategies

price_vs_sma200.description: Price vs SMA-200 ratio: regime detection (bull/bear).
price_vs_sma200.evidence: Long-term trend indicator; institutional standard for regime detection
